description: This file defines the SubunitAPI class in PHP, which provides API endpoints for managing organizational subunits within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting subunits, along with corresponding validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: SubunitAPI
classes.description: A PHP class providing REST API endpoints for managing organizational subunits, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a single subunit by ID, returning a SubunitModel object.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the ID parameter is positive.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all subunits, with optional depth and mode query parameters to control the output structure.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, validating the optional query parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new subunit under a specified parent subunit, validating input parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new subunit, including fields like parentId, name, description, and unitId.

methods.name: setParamsToSubunit
methods.description: Populates a Subunit entity with parameters from the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing subunit identified by ID with provided data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a subunit, including handling entity uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a subunit identified by ID, ensuring it is not the top-level node.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete operation, ensuring the ID is greater than 1.
